# Slime People
Comprised of slime, this humanoid species breathes nitrogen instead of oxygen. Which, while it is abundant in the station air, it is harder to find compressed into gas tanks. They exhale nitrous oxide and are unaffected by it.
## Unique Abilities
### Membrane Storage
- Slimepeople have an [bold]internal 2x3 storage inventory[/bold] inside of their slime membrane. - Anyone can see what's inside and take it out of you without asking, so be careful.
## Diet - Slime Blood is technically a source of moderately filling food for other species, although drinking the blood of your coworkers is usually frowned upon.
## Benefits
- They [color=#1e90ff]suffocate 80% slower.[/color] This makes them by far the species most capable to survive in hard vacuum. For a while. - They take [color=#1e90ff]40% less Blunt damage and 20% less Poison damage[/color] - Slimepeople have [color=#1e90ff]accelerated regeneration[/color] compared to other humanoids. - Slimepeople have [color=#1e90ff]no bones to break.[/color]
## Drawbacks
- They take [color=#ffa500]significant damage if they are sprayed or splashed with water[/color], but can (and like other species, need to) drink it safely to stay hydrated. - They take [color=#ffa500]50% more Cold damage, 15% more Slash damage and 15% more Piercing damage[/color]. - As a result of their lack of bones, [color=#ffa500]their limbs come off easier.[/color] - Their body [color=#ffa500]processes only two toxins at a time[/color] compared to three. - They take [color=#ffa500]pressure damage 9% faster.[/color]
## Slime Person Naming Conventions
Slimes typically use the Human naming convention, but frequently have less plausible names than most Humans, and often include onomatopoeia. Last names are optional. - [color=#449944]Acceptable:[/color] Foolp Suub - [color=#449944]Acceptable:[/color] Foolp - [color=#449944]Acceptable:[/color] Andie Fizt - [color=#449944]Acceptable:[/color] Flanna Gleef - [color=#994444]Bad:[/color] Slime - [color=#994444]Bad:[/color] Rimuru Tempest
## Lore
Rather than a traditional planet, the Slime Person species originates from a large planet-sized slime ball that exists in space. They would come to populate different planetoids in the form of slime rain on those worlds. Culturally, most slimes have developed a slight carelessness for injury due to their inherent lack of need for certain parts to function unlike other species, such as not needing a head.
